title: Add 'aghist index' idempotent CLI command (delta-aware)
description:
attached_molecule: ahist-wisp-g8cm
attached_formula: mol-polecat-work
attached_at: 2026-05-01T23:58:18Z
dispatched_by: unknown
formula_vars: base_branch=main

Promote internal background indexer to a CLI subcommand. --provider <id> for partial. Exits 0 with stats on stdout JSON. Reports unchanged/added/updated counts. Safe to run repeatedly.
notes:
Implemented `aghist index` subcommand:

- New CLI: `aghist index [--provider <id>] [--force]`
- Idempotent + delta-aware (manifest-based mtime tracking, already existed)
- Stdout JSON: {providers, sessions_total, added, updated, unchanged, messages_indexed, force, index_dir, duration_ms, errors[]}
- Exit 0 on success, exit 1 on unknown provider id
- Provider IDs: claude_code, copilot_cli, gemini_cli, codex_cli, opencode (also accepts shortened aliases)
- AGHIST_INDEX_DIR env var honored by SearchIndex::default_index_dir() so users + tests can isolate

Code changes:
- src/main.rs: new Index subcommand + run_index() helper
- src/search.rs: extended IndexStats with added/updated/unchanged; AGHIST_INDEX_DIR override
- src/model/provider.rs: added Provider::id() and Provider::from_id()
- tests/cli_e2e.rs: 4 new e2e tests (no-data, idempotent, provider filter, unknown provider)
- tests/cross_component.rs: assertions on new IndexStats fields

Pre-existing test failures (Windows path tests) and clippy warnings in untouched files were not addressed.

title: CLI primitives: search/json/exit-codes/schema introspection
Agent-first CLI: make aghist usable by AI agents (not just TUI users)
description:
**Goal**: Turn aghist from a TUI-with-some-flags into a CLI that AI agents can use programmatically — `aghist search`, `aghist export`, `aghist index`, `aghist mcp`, all with stable JSON output, deterministic ordering, and machine-readable errors.

**Why**: aghist already indexes 5 providers (Claude Code, Copilot, Gemini, Codex, OpenCode) with Tantivy. The TUI is the only consumer. Agents (and other tools) cannot search or filter from the CLI without entering the TUI.

**Reference research** (from session 2026-05-02):
- Closest competitors: CASS (`Dicklesworthstone/coding_agent_session_search`, 19 agents, SQLite + Tantivy + FastEmbed + RRF, MCP-friendly CLI), claude-history (Rust, Claude-only, indexes tool outputs).
- Agent-CLI design refs: beads `AGENTS.md`, `gt`, `gh`, `rg`, `ck`, `lnget` PR #14, googleworkspace/cli (runtime schema dump).
- MCP memory ecosystem: Mem0, mcp-memory-service, claude-context, ck (--serve mode).

**Scope** — sub-epics:
- ahist-? CLI primitives (search/json/exit-codes/schema)
- ahist-? Filters & citations (provider/since/role refs)
- ahist-? Index management (idempotent, observable)
- ahist-? Semantic search (FastEmbed, RRF, opt-in download)
- ahist-? MCP server (`aghist mcp` stdio)
- ahist-? Cross-machine sources (CASS-style remote indexes)
- ahist-? Decision/TODO extraction (research)

**Non-goals (this epic):** TUI overhaul, server-mode HTTP, write paths into agent histories.

Polecat clones inherit stale .beads/dolt-server.port from origin/main
description:
**Root cause** (verified 2026-05-02 via polecat furiosa autopsy):

bd's port resolution priority in worktrees:
1. Env var `BEADS_DOLT_PORT` — wins if set
2. `.beads/dolt-server.port` runtime file — but this is gitignored, so polecat worktrees never have it
3. `.beads/metadata.json` — bd documents this as "local, gitignored" and may not trust committed values
4. `.beads/config.yaml` `dolt.port: <N>` — should be honored but evidently isn't picked up by polecat clones

So polecat worktrees fall through to bd's compiled-in default (3307, which is HQ's port) and fail with `database "ahist" not found`.

**Inline fix shipped:** AGENTS.md now documents the `export BEADS_DOLT_PORT=$(cat /home/tien/projects/agent-history/.beads/dolt-server.port)` workaround so polecats find it in seconds.

**Real fix (deferred — likely upstream gt or bd):**
- Option A (gt): mol-polecat-work formula exports `BEADS_DOLT_PORT` from the project's live port file before invoking the polecat session.
- Option B (bd): honor `dolt.port` in committed `.beads/config.yaml` as the canonical default when no runtime port file exists.
- Option C (project): add a wrapper script (`.beads/hooks/...` or `~/gt/aghist/bin/bd`) that sets the env var on every bd invocation. Hacky.

Closing this issue once one of A/B is shipped upstream. For now the AGENTS.md workaround is sufficient.

title: tests: copilot_v2/opencode_v2 discover_sessions fail on Linux due to Windows-style path parsing
description:
On Linux, two tests in tests/provider_format_diagnostic.rs fail because they expect a Windows-path normalization that doesn't apply on the host:

- copilot_v2_discover_sessions: assertion expected Some("myapp"), got Some("C:\\Users\\test\\myapp")
- opencode_v2_discover_sessions: assertion expected Some("myproject"), got Some("C:\\Users\\test\\myproject")

These were pre-existing on origin/main before ahist-y3o.1.1 (search subcommand) was implemented. The fixtures contain Windows paths (C:\\Users\\test\\...) and the providers are not extracting the basename when the path is Windows-style on a Linux host.

Likely fix: normalize/extract the basename in the copilot/opencode session discovery code, or split on both / and \\ when computing project_name.

title: Expose resource URIs: aghist://session/<id> and aghist://session/<id>/turn/<n>
description: Standard MCP resources. Lets clients (Claude Desktop, Cursor) browse sessions like files. Stable across reindex (uses citation refs).

title: Implement 'aghist mcp' stdio MCP server
description: JSON-RPC over stdio per MCP spec. Tools: search_sessions, get_session, list_sessions, get_message, reindex, health. Reuses --params validation from SE_CLI.

title: Embedding cache invalidation keyed by message content hash
description: Avoid recomputing embeddings on reindex. Hash message text → embedding map persisted as a sidecar table. Eviction on schema bump.

title: Implement RRF hybrid scoring (lexical + semantic)
description: Reciprocal Rank Fusion of Tantivy BM25 + FastEmbed cosine. Fail open: if no embeddings, return lexical only. Tunable via --hybrid-weight.

title: Integrate FastEmbed (opt-in via --accept-download)
description: Add fastembed-rs. Default model: all-MiniLM-L6 (~90MB). Embeddings stored alongside Tantivy index. CASS-style: do not auto-download — require explicit --accept-download flag once.

title: Add --watch mode to search emitting NDJSON on new sessions
description: Long-running stream. Sessions land → emit one NDJSON line per new hit matching the saved query. Useful for 'agent of agents' watching another agent's progress.

title: Add --debug-search explainer
description: Shows BM25 score breakdown per result. Pattern from raine/claude-history --debug-search. Helps tune relevance and surfaces ranking surprises.

title: Add --params accepting full JSON request body
description: lnget pattern. Lets agents skip per-flag discovery and submit a JSON request. Validated against the same schema 'aghist schema' returns. Useful for MCP server reuse.

description: Scan for 'TODO', 'follow-up', 'come back to', 'we should', plus open bd refs. Cross-reference with closed status (e.g., bd issue mentioned + bd shows closed → drop).

title: Federated search across local + remote indexes
description: search subcommand iterates over all configured sources (local first, then remote with marker in result.source field). Concurrent fanout, partial-failure tolerant.

title: Spike: 'aghist decisions' — extract architectural decisions from sessions

title: SSH/rsync index sync (CASS pattern)
description: rsync the remote machine's session JSONL into a local cache, reindex, attribute hits to the source host. --pull on demand or periodically.

title: Source registry: 'aghist sources add/list/remove'
description: Stores remote sources (host, path, transport). Local sources auto-detected; remote require explicit add. Persist in config.toml under [[sources]].

title: MCP scoping: per-provider allowlist, read-only enforcement
description: Some users won't want all 5 providers visible to a given client. Config knob: providers.mcp_exposed = [...]. Enforce read-only — never let a tool call mutate history.

title: Bench lexical-only vs hybrid recall on a labeled query set
description: Build a small fixture of (query, expected_session_id) pairs. Measure recall@10 and MRR for lexical, semantic, and hybrid. Document results.

mol-polecat-work
description:
Full polecat work lifecycle from assignment through completion.

This molecule guides a polecat through a complete work assignment. Each step
has clear entry/exit criteria and specific commands to run. A polecat can
crash after any step and resume from the last completed step.

## Polecat Contract (Self-Cleaning Model)

You are a self-cleaning worker. You:
1. Receive work via your hook (formula checklist + issue)
2. Work through formula steps in order (shown inline at prime time)
3. Complete and self-clean via `gt done` (submit + nuke yourself)
4. You are GONE - Refinery merges from MQ

**Self-cleaning:** When you run `gt done`, you push your work, submit to MQ,
nuke your sandbox, and exit. There is no idle state. Done means gone.

**Important:** This formula defines the workflow template. Steps are shown inline
when you run `gt prime` — there are no separate step beads to close. Work through
the checklist, then run `gt done`.

**Speed principle:** You run the full gate suite AFTER rebasing onto the target
branch (pre-verify step). This enables the refinery to fast-path merge your MR
in ~5 seconds instead of re-running gates. If pre-verification is skipped or
stale, the refinery falls through to normal gate execution.

**You do NOT:**
- Push directly to main (Refinery merges from MQ)
- Close your own issue (Refinery closes after merge)
- Wait for merge (you're gone after `gt done`)
- Fix pre-existing failures on main (Refinery owns main health)

## Variables

| Variable | Source | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| issue | hook_bead | The issue ID you're assigned to work on |
| base_branch | sling vars | The base branch to rebase on (default: main) |
| setup_command | rig config | Setup/install command (e.g., `pnpm install`). Empty = skip. |
| typecheck_command | rig config | Type check command (e.g., `tsc --noEmit`). Empty = skip. |
| test_command | rig config | Test command. Empty = skip. Rig must configure for its language. |
| lint_command | rig config | Lint command (e.g., `eslint .`). Empty = skip. |
| build_command | rig config | Build command (e.g., `go build ./...`). Empty = skip. |

## Failure Modes

| Situation | Action |
|-----------|--------|
| Build fails | Fix it. Do not proceed if it won't compile. |
| Blocked on external | Mail Witness for help, mark yourself stuck |
| Context filling | Use gt handoff to cycle to fresh session |
| Unsure what to do | Mail Witness, don't guess |

branch (pre-verify step). This enables the refinery to fast-path merge your MR
in ~5 seconds instead of re-running gates. If pre-verification is skipped or
stale, the refinery falls through to normal gate execution.

- Push directly to main (Refinery merges from MQ)

| Context filling | Use gt handoff to cycle to fresh session |
